comment: Methylates C-3 of the α-keto acid 4-methyl-2-oxovalerate; the product is transaminated to (R)-3-methyl-L-leucine, a building block of viridogrisein. SgvM shows high promiscuity and can modify a variety of 2-oxo acids

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 fixed reaction SMARTS and added example substrate-product pairs.

reactions.description: C-methylation of C-3 of 4-methyl-2-oxovalerate to give (3R)-3,4-dimethyl-2-oxopentanoate
Conversion of non-natural substrate phenylpyruvate into 3-methylphenylpyruvate
